outcome: Time from surgery to initiation of enteral feeds
cohort: The study included 75 term neonates who underwent cardiac surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass between September 2015 and 2019, excluding those unable to separate from bypass, requiring long-term dialysis, or long-term mechanical ventilation.
finding: The study found no significant difference in net fluid balance, vasoactive inotropic score, or secondary clinical outcomes (mechanical ventilation duration, ICU/hospital length of stay, time to enteral feeds) between neonates who received post-operative hydrocortisone and those who did not.
